name: sound-flags-we
description: Sound flags, dialogue words and the import list of new sounds against the WE's own save (branch sound-flags-we, 2026-11-15, SD; input make-sound-flags-input.mjs: random-group.w3m, no sounds, no import list; beep.wav a 0.25 s 16-bit mono tone). WE (Sound Editor, F5; File menu 109,131: Use As Sound 147,271, Replace Internal Sound 175,314; Import Sound Ctrl+I; the tree keeps its scroll and folders for the editor's session, so a click on a tree row and Home first, and the spec wants a freshly started editor or a run of its own): (1) Sound > Interface, its first file AchievementEarned.flac, Use As Sound; (2) Replace Internal Sound with beep.wav (the tree's file still selected); (3) Import Sound beep.wav (it shows at the tree's bottom, 177,864), Use As Sound; (4) Sound > Dialogue > Extra, its first file AAGAREK_Death1.ogg, Use As Sound. Studio: the same by the Sound Editor's Add as sound, w3.sounds.replace (file dialog and question stubbed), the Import Manager's Import files (stubbed), Add as sound from its Imported tab; the input's old war3map.j deleted so w3.script.generate writes. Same in WE and Studio (asserted): every new sound, the Dialogue one too, gets dialogueTextKey and speakerNameKey -1, dialogueText and speakerName empty, unknown1 0, unknown2 1 (the Sound Properties dialog has no dialogue, speaker or music fields, also for a Dialogue sound, so no keyed sound is made here); the imported file's sound gets flags 0x10 (16), the game ones 0; the imported file's list entry war3mapImported\beep.wav flags 21. Known differences (ignored above, expected in the script): the WE writes paths with / (sounds' file and assetFile, CreateSound, the replaced file's list entry), Studio \; Replace Internal Sound keeps the game's name (Sound/Interface/AchievementEarned.flac holding the .wav bytes) with list flags 21 at this save (13 at the next save after another change: exploration twice), Studio writes Sound\Interface\AchievementEarned.wav with 13; a labelled game sound takes the label's numbers in the WE (fade 0, priority 1000, pitchVariance 1, AchievementEarned channel 8, maxDistance 0, distanceCutoff 10000, eaxEffect DefaultEAXON; AAGarek_Death1 volume 120, minDistance 3000, distanceCutoff 100000; coneOutsideVolume -1), Studio fade 10, priority 8, the rest unset and AchievementEarned's eaxEffect "0"; the imported file's sound: WE fade 0, priority 100, coneOutsideVolume 127, assetFile its file, Studio 10, 8, 0, empty. Script: WE no SetSoundDuration for any of the three (Studio 250, 250, 3583; the WE wrote SetSoundDuration -1 for the replaced sound once when saved right after the replace, gone at the next save), Studio a SetSoundChannel 0 for AchievementEarned (channel -1), and the WE lists the trigger's global before the sounds. Stable on three WE runs. Expected OK (w3s and imp MATCH with the ignores, the script DIFFERS)
